reuse.why: Routes every inline midpoint copy (schedule actions, posting, preview, forecast, schedule templates) through the existing exported getScheduledAmount.

duplication.why: Removes four inline copies of the ranged-amount rule; the new worst-case logic is written once in getWorstCaseAmount.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside getScheduledAmount, which client and server already import.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its call sites and tests change.

maintainability.why: One definition now governs the rule; schedule-template still keeps its own op === 'isbetween' dispatch around the call, a small leftover a maintainer might trim.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All ranged-amount sites now call getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: Duplicated copies are removed rather than reshaped.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount/getWorstCaseAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, forecast-schedules and schedule-template.
